name: Nereus and his sister
title: Believers in the Roman church
summary: Nereus and his sister were Christians in Rome whom Paul greets in his letter to the Romans. They are mentioned together with other believers in the household of Philologus and Julia, suggesting that they were part of a house church in the imperial capital.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sends greetings to Nereus and his sister along with other believers in Rome, showing that they were recognized members of the Christian community there.

keyEvents.title: Part of a house church
keyEvents.description: Nereus and his sister are mentioned together with Philologus, Julia, and Olympas, as well as all the saints who are with them, indicating that they belonged to a house church in Rome.
